commit.message:
feat(polls): add closePoll and a POLL_CLOSED event (#3139)

* feat(polls): add closePoll and a POLL_CLOSED event

closePoll and answerPoll return a promise that is rejected with the error
condition (e.g. not-allowed) when the polls component rejects the message, so
the app can tell the user that closing or answering did not work. The component
does not acknowledge an accepted message, so the promise resolves when no error
reply arrives within POLLS_REPLY_TIMEOUT.

POLL_CLOSED documents its payload, including the server's copy of the answers
sent to visitors.

* fix(polls): clear the reply timeout on an error reply and note the API change

answerPoll returned nothing before. A caller that ignores the returned promise
now gets an unhandled rejection when an answer is refused.

@@ -398,6 +398,22 @@ export enum JitsiConferenceEvents {
      */
     POLL_ANSWER_RECEIVED = 'conference.pollAnswerReceived',
 
+    /**
+     * A poll was closed, thus it does not take answers anymore. The listener receives the message of the polls
+     * component: {
+     *     pollId: string,       // the id of the closed poll
+     *     senderId?: string,    // the occupant id of the participant that closed it
+     *     answers?: Array<{     // the server's copy of the results, sent only where the client may not have them,
+     *         name: string,     // i.e. to visitors, whose node learns about the close from the main prosody;
+     *         voters?: Array<{  // when present it is the authoritative final result and replaces the local one
+     *             id: string,
+     *             name?: string
+     *         }>
+     *     }>
+     * }
+     */
+    POLL_CLOSED = 'conference.pollClosed',
+
     /**
      * A new poll was received or a poll is loaded from the history.
      */

@@ -309,6 +309,11 @@ export enum XMPPEvents {
      */
     POLLS_ANSWER_EVENT = 'xmpp.polls.answer.event',
 
+    /**
